scalars.scalar_value: Five or more years Paramedic experience

items.item_text: Five or more years Paramedic experience
Assures departmental competency and compliance to all regulatory, accreditation and hospital standards of care.

Prepares and justifies annual budgeting including, Anticipates realistic volume trends, Maintains an effective staffing plan, Determines productive and non-productive expenditures, Determines and prioritizes capital expenditures, Determines non-labor expense requirements justified by volume trends and department needs, Coordinates capital equipment budget in collaboration with the medical staff.
Implements control in fiscal management of the department, Manages department budget within fiscal year approved targets.

Maintains adequate staffing for daily needs reflecting cost efficiency, Recruits, hires and releases staff, Assigns staff and workload, respecting changing priorities in daily operations, Provides counsel, monitors performance, directs orientation, provides guidance and constructively influences staff morale, Carries out corrective and/or disciplinary action as necessary, Provides cross-training programs to utilize staff at highest productive standards possible, Participates in sponsoring students in the department and fostering relationships with associated educational programs.

Develops, implements and monitors department safety management programs which includes Workers' Compensation, patient safety and written safety procedures specific to departmental hazards, chemical hygiene, MSDS, accident investigations, safety training, bi-annual inspections, and safety policy enforcement procedures.

Works in collaboration with the Department Managers and Directors to develop and implement integrated policies and procedures. Ensures that standards and policies and procedures are followed in daily practice.
